parts.title: Part 1 – Sentence comprehension

parts.title: Part 2 + 3 – Text cohesion
parts.instructions: The sentences below make a complete text. Put them in the correct order.

parts.title: Part 4 – Opinion matching
parts.instructions: Four people write reviews of a new restaurant in their town on a website. Read the texts and then answer the questions below.
parts.passage_text:
A
I'm not sure if I will return to this restaurant. I think the staff was arguing when I got there, because the atmosphere here was not very comfortable. As for the food, I think there's nothing to write about. I ordered fish and chips, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't good either. But many people say that the food here is fabulous. So, I think I'm an exception.

B
This is a very famous restaurant that I saw in the newspaper. Sadly, I arrived later than the rest of the party, so I didn't get to order dinner. However, I ordered orange juice and mango juice and they were both delicious. What about the surroundings? Lively music along with fashionable and appropriate decor makes me feel very comfortable.

C
I don't understand why this restaurant is so famous. When I arrived and saw a menu with lots of different dishes, I saw this as a bad sign. Furthermore, the menu with traditional dishes contrasting with the modern decoration style made me feel very confused and strange. The waiters here were also not friendly. This was one of my worst experiences eating at a restaurant.

D
This is my first time coming to this restaurant. The food is very cheap but the quality is excellent. I was very surprised with the starter because its menu is very diverse. But there is one thing that I want the restaurant to improve. The restaurant band played live music but it was very far away, so the sound was very low and it didn't make the meal atmosphere lively. Next time turn the music louder, please!

questions.prompt: Who thought the music was too quiet?
Who didn't eat anything at the restaurant?
Who will definitely not return to the restaurant?
Who thought their bad experience was probably unusual?
Who was impressed by the range of appetizers?
Who thought the food was of average quality?

parts.title: Part 5 – Long reading
parts.instructions: Read the passage quickly. Choose a heading for each numbered paragraph from the drop-down box.

questions.prompt: Paragraph 1: Recent research into childhood health reveals that children around the world are spending significantly less time being physically active than previous generations.
options: Technology is not the only cause of inactivity
The physical and mental perils of sedentary life
Parental encouragement makes a vital difference
The long-term economic burden of health issues
Small daily habits for lifelong wellbeing
questions.correct_answer: Technology is not the only cause of inactivity

questions.prompt: Paragraph 2: The lack of regular exercise has immediate and far-reaching consequences on young bodies and minds.
options: Technology is not the only cause of inactivity
The physical and mental perils of sedentary life
Parental encouragement makes a vital difference
The long-term economic burden of health issues
Small daily habits for lifelong wellbeing
questions.correct_answer: The physical and mental perils of sedentary life
